captureGuidance: Use natural light; avoid direct flash on the cornea.
Capture both eyes at similar angles when possible.
Note if the dog is squinting or pawing at the eye.

findingFields.label: Corneal clarity
findingFields.description: Estimate of corneal transparency from photo

findingFields.label: Squinting / blepharospasm
findingFields.description: Eyelid closure or squinting suggestive of discomfort

findingFields.label: Epiphora (tearing)
findingFields.description: Visible tear staining or wetness below medial canthus

findingFields.label: Conjunctival redness
findingFields.description: Redness of conjunctiva visible in photo

suggestedDiagnostics: Corneal cytology if discharge is purulent
